req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /cookies returns a JSON object with a 'cookies' key mapping cookie names to values. Tests must cover: (1) positive path with one or more cookies present, (2) negative/empty path with no cookies, (3) boundary with exactly one cookie vs zero cookies, (4) multiple cookies, (5) env-cookie filtering behavior. Mutation-resilient assertions check exact status codes (200), exact JSON structure keys ('cookies'), exact cookie values, and exact empty-dict behavior. Both sides of the hide_env branch are exercised.

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
A single cookie 'session' with value 'abc123' is sent in the request
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_single():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data == {'cookies': {'session': 'abc123'}}
    assert data['cookies']['session'] == 'abc123'
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type

test_get_cookies_single()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_boundary_exactly_one_cookie
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Exactly one cookie is present (boundary between zero and multiple)
actions: Send GET /cookies with exactly one cookie 'k=v'
expected: JSON body has exactly one entry in 'cookies'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_boundary_one():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'k=v'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1
    assert data['cookies']['k'] == 'v'
    assert data == {'cookies': {'k': 'v'}}

test_get_cookies_boundary_one()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_multiple_cookies_returns_all
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing three cookies
expected: JSON body cookies dict has exactly 3 entries
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_multiple():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'a=1; b=2; c=3'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 3
    assert data['cookies']['a'] == '1'
    assert data['cookies']['b'] == '2'
    assert data['cookies']['c'] == '3'
    assert data == {'cookies': {'a': '1', 'b': '2', 'c': '3'}}

test_get_cookies_multiple()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_response_structure_has_cookies_key_not_other_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Inspect top-level keys of JSON response
expected: Top-level JSON has exactly one key: 'cookies'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_structure():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'foo=bar'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'cookies'}
    assert len(data.keys()) == 1

tests.name: test_get_cookies_boundary_zero_vs_one_transition
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
First request has zero cookies, second has one cookie
actions: Send GET /cookies with no cookies -> assert empty
Send GET /cookies with one cookie 'x=y' -> assert exactly one entry
expected: Transition from 0 to 1 cookie is correctly reflected
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_zero_to_one_boundary():
    r0 = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    d0 = r0.get_json()
    assert d0 == {'cookies': {}}
    assert len(d0['cookies']) == 0

    r1 = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'x=y'})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    d1 = r1.get_json()
    assert d1 == {'cookies': {'x': 'y'}}
    assert len(d1['cookies']) == 1
    assert d1['cookies']['x'] == 'y'

test_get_cookies_zero_to_one_boundary()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_cookie_value_with_special_characters
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
A cookie with a value containing alphanumeric characters is sent
expected: Value is not truncated or modified
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_exact_value_preserved():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'token=abc123XYZ'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['cookies']['token'] == 'abc123XYZ'
    assert data['cookies']['token'] != 'abc123'
    assert data['cookies']['token'] != 'abc123XY'
    assert data['cookies']['token'] != 'abc123XYZA'
    assert data == {'cookies': {'token': 'abc123XYZ'}}

test_get_cookies_exact_value_preserved()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_state_transition_set_then_list
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Manually set a cookie in the request and call GET /cookies
Verify the cookie appears in the response
expected: cookies dict contains the manually set cookie with exact name and value
State: cookie present -> listed in response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_state_set_then_list():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'mykey=myvalue'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'mykey' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['mykey'] == 'myvalue'
    assert data == {'cookies': {'mykey': 'myvalue'}}
